data.title: Recruitment Closing Soon for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator,
Recruitment for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II will close on 2025-11-17 at 05:00 (UTC-5). You won't be able to access the recruitment survey after that time, so be sure to submit your application before the deadline. Details on test access distribution will be announced later. Stay tuned to our official channels for updates.
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Recruitment for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II will close on 2025-11-17 at 05:00 (UTC-5). You won't be able to access the recruitment survey after that time, so be sure to submit your application before the deadline. Details on test access distribution will be announced later. Stay tuned to our official channels for updates.


▼// Recruitment Survey

Complete the recruitment survey for a chance to join Beta Test II.

Survey link: https://survey.gryphline.com/s/307f02139423c46f3fdb9fa69e3a1eda


▼// Test Period

The test will officially begin on 2025-11-27 at 22:00 (UTC-5)


▼// Test Overview

Platforms: PC & Mobile (Android/iOS)

Test Type: Limited-access, free of charge, data-wipe test

Period: 2025-11-27 at 22:00 (UTC-5) – End date to be announced

Game Languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Russian

Voice Languages: Mandarin, English, Japanese, Korean


▼// Additional Notes

1. Once the Beta Test II recruitment ends, selected Endministrators will be notified via the email linked to their GRYPHLINE Account used during sign-up. For details on test access distribution, stay tuned to our official announcements.

2. All content available for experience in Beta Test II is from a work-in-progress build and does not represent the final look and quality of the game.

3. Beta Test II is only open to adults. If you are a minor under the laws of your country or region, you are not eligible for test access. If the age you provide in the survey is found to be false, your test access will be revoked.

4. Beta Test II access is valid only for this testing phase and limited to one per Gryphline account. Selected Endministrators will be granted access to both PC and mobile (Android or iOS, based on their survey response). Game data will sync across platforms when using the same account.
